comment: The real arena (NOT run yet): the overhead camera plays the drone and locates the rover, the RaspRover drives, its camera service (rover_mapper/perception_service.py, port 8095) corrects the map, a second camera serves tiles over HTTP. Replace the addresses, set metres_per_pixel (measured on a picture of this camera; null: the camera is refused, as lancer_overhead --camera without --metres-par-pixel) and marker_height (top of the marker above the floor, m). Declare sensors and locators before the rover that uses them.
